question: Which bounded reader states are observed when a SQLite WAL writer commits while a reader transaction is held?

carrier.description: Finite reader and writer visibility states in the fixed two-connection protocol.

state_space.description: A writer commits one appended row while a reader transaction remains open; the reader then ends its transaction and refreshes.

transitions.name: Begin reader snapshot
transitions.label: reader begins transaction over four seed rows

transitions.name: Commit writer append
transitions.label: writer commits fifth row while reader remains open

transitions.name: Refresh reader transaction
transitions.label: reader commits held transaction and begins a new one

laws_or_checks.name: Initial state
laws_or_checks.description: The protocol begins in the seeded state.

laws_or_checks.name: Transition closure
laws_or_checks.description: Declared transitions remain within the finite state carrier.

assumptions: The carrier is a bounded observational projection of one fixed WAL protocol, not a complete SQLite transaction model.
The reader-held state is represented by its four-row query result before and after the writer commit.
Null timing measurements and untested failure conditions do not imply zero latency or absence of failures.

classification.reason: All declared transitions are closed over the finite state space and the protocol has an initial state.

result.summary: In three repetitions, the held reader continued to see four rows during the writer's five-row committed state, and a newly begun reader transaction saw five rows.

limitations: The result is bounded to one fixed dataset, three repetitions, one host, and one SQLite build.
The result does not test crashes, power loss, checkpoint behavior, busy handling, durability, or performance.

result.summary: The bounded WAL visibility protocol did not establish rollback, crash, power-loss, checkpoint, busy, durability, or performance behavior.

validation_records.question: Did this protocol establish behavior for untested failure, durability, checkpoint, or performance conditions?
validation_records.what_not_established: No result for those untested conditions was established by this protocol.
limitations: This is an absence-of-evidence record, not a negative finding about SQLite.
A dedicated protocol is required for each omitted condition.
